comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item's recipe is available from the Shipwright in the Acropolis of Atlantis by the Harbor Port Official -- and only if Atlantis is currently in UWO.

Name: Making Special Rudder
Skills: Handicrafts R12/Shipbuilding R12
Ingredients:
Resin x15
Teak Paneling

Cheers.

comments.author: Tale_
comments.body:
it can also be made in Manchester!

Shipwright
Name: Making High-performance Rudder
Skills: Handicrafts R15/Shipbuilding R13
Ingredients:
Suede x5
Control Tower x1
North American Teak Paneling x1

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Reminder: this item can be produced in Atlantis until Atlantis departs on 6/5. Cheers.
